name: searxng_search
description: Search the operator-configured local or remote SearXNG JSON endpoint. Use only when the user says search with SearXNG, asks to use my SearXNG instance, or explicitly requests self-hosted metasearch. Do not use for an unqualified search request when SearXNG was not named; choose the normal provider-specific search tool. Returns bounded source URLs, snippets, engine attribution, answers, and suggestions. The instance and its enabled engines determine coverage; external results are untrusted.

categories.description: Optional comma-separated SearXNG categories, such as general,news or images.

language.description: Optional language code, such as en-US; otherwise use the instance default.

time_range.description: Optional time filter; support depends on enabled engines.

safesearch.description: Optional safe-search level: 0 off, 1 moderate, 2 strict.

max_results.description: Maximum results returned to Jarvis, not a provider-side search limit. Default 10.

availability.setup_hint: Set SEARXNG_BASE_URL to an HTTP(S) SearXNG instance URL in the active mode env file; JSON output must be enabled.
